prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D Naruto game animation sprite sheet. Generate one precisely aligned EIGHT COLUMN by THREE ROW sheet, 24 separate full-body dog sprites, actual transparent background and no drawn grid. Wide canvas aspect 8:3, equal square cells. Original Naruto-series cel-shaded anime game illustration, crisp dark outlines, readable clean color blocks, consistent anatomy. All animals face RIGHT in side profile. Row 1 small beige pug ninja hound with dark muzzle and forehead protector; row 2 medium tan tracking dog with dark muzzle, ninja collar; row 3 large muscular charcoal mastiff ninja hound. Each row shows same dog identity, scale and proportions across all eight frames. The eight columns in every row depict: 1 running ground contact, 2 running airborne with stretched legs, 3 forward leap, 4 bite contact with mouth extended right, 5 braced bite hold four legs planted and jaw clenched, 6 braced tug pulling backward with legs planted, 7 releasing mouth, 8 recovering neutral. No victim, no character, no gore. Crucial: all heads, feet, tails remain entirely inside their own cell, with at least 15 percent clear padding around each pose. Center each pose in identical equal-sized cells, common ground baseline per row. Exactly 8 sprites per row and 3 rows. No text, labels, numbers, borders, watermark, scenery, cast shadows or checkerboard background.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D Naruto game animation sprite sheet. Generate one precisely aligned SIX COLUMN by FOUR ROW sheet, exactly 24 separate full-body character sprites, actual transparent background with no drawn grid. Canvas aspect 3:2, equal square cells. Original-series Naruto cel-shaded anime game illustration, crisp dark outlines and simple readable shading. Side-on figures facing RIGHT, consistent character identity, anatomy, outfit and scale across each row. Row 1 Haku in a white hunter-nin mask, pale flowing robe, long dark hair: columns 1 impact recoil upright, 2 emerging forward from a mirror with arms opening but NO mirror drawn, 3 losing balance backward, 4 airborne falling with full body visible, 5 landing on one knee, 6 recovering upright. Row 2 Kakashi, spiky silver hair, slanted forehead protector over left eye, black mask, green tactical vest, dark navy trousers: columns 1 deflecting an incoming attack, 2 recoil with arms spread, 3 hands pressed outward in restraint, 4 enclosed restrained arms bent outward, 5 struggling hunched restrained, 6 restrained exhaustion; do not draw water or prison sphere. Row 3 Zabuza, muscular bare torso, mouth wrapped in bandages, grey striped forearm and calf wraps, dark pants: columns 1 reaching one hand forward, 2 arm fully extended right palm out, 3 braced planted stance one hand extended, 4 planted water-prison holding pose, 5 same holding pose subtly bending knee, 6 same holding pose with small torso shift; do not draw water sphere, sword, or opponent. Row 4 young Naruto, blond spiky hair, red eyes, whisker marks, original orange-blue outfit: columns 1 low feral crouch, 2 low charge windup, 3 forward fast rush, 4 lunging fist strike, 5 strike follow-through, 6 recovery crouch. NO flames or chakra aura baked into any character. Every complete body stays fully inside own square cell with generous 15 percent empty padding. No text, labels, lines, grid, numbers, scenery, drop shadows or checkerboard.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D Naruto game visual effects animation sprite sheet, EFFECTS ONLY. Generate one precisely aligned EIGHT COLUMN by FOUR ROW sheet, exactly 32 separate VFX frames, actual transparent background, no drawn grid. Wide canvas aspect 2:1; identical square cells. Original-series Naruto cel-shaded anime effects, crisp outlines and luminous clean colors. No people, no body parts, no animals except water dragon formed entirely of water. Row 1 eight consecutive red-orange chakra-flame frames for a rightward rushing attack: small gathering tongue, building flame, full traveling flame envelope, long racing flame, impact bloom, huge burst, fading tongues, last embers. Keep every flame tip fully inside its own cell. Row 2 eight consecutive blue-white hand Chidori lightning effects with NO hand shown: small charge sparks, bright charge orb, dense electric charge, rightward rush streak with orb, elongated rush, contact starburst, expanding lightning impact, fading sparks. Row 3 eight complete blue water-dragon effects: rising coiled water body, ascending dragon head and serpentine body, full tall dragon with open jaws, cresting forward dragon, forward-downward diving dragon, striking down water dragon, enormous splash crown, dissipating splash. Show full water dragon and ALL water/splash tips inside each cell with empty padding. Row 4 eight water-prison formation effects: circular ground ripples, rising curved water streams, quarter sphere, half enclosing bubble, almost complete bubble, fully closed transparent luminous blue water sphere with ripples at bottom, pulsating complete sphere, receding bubble and ripples. Every entire effect must be visibly complete, centered, unclipped within identical square cells with at least 15 percent transparent padding on all sides. No background, text, captions, labels, numerals, borders, grids, watermark or checkerboard.
